notes.title: Between Realities: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/d380cf4989b4255c29b1e1811ca3a7ac3e6a02dc.png"][/img]
[/p][p]The world of [i]Among The Trolls[/i] is steeped in mystery - some gradually revealed through the story, others more deeply hidden within the forest. Uncovering them is a task for the most attentive explorers, who will slowly piece together details and tales from a distant past. 
[/p][p]A lot of the characters in Among The Trolls are based on the stories in the [b][i]Kalevala[/i][/b], an epic poem that Elias Lönnrot put together in the middle of the 19th century. He used traditional songs and folk poetry to put together the historical memory of the Finnish people, combining the cosmogonic origins and the mythological cycle into one work. These fascinating writings have been the focus of our in-depth study, to which - in some cases - we have added our own artistic interpretation, as many descriptions of certain entities leave plenty of room… [i]for imagination[/i].  
[/p][p]Below, you’ll find some examples of the kind of notes you’ll be able to discover while exploring. Think of them as a small taste - full versions will be waiting for you directly in Among The Trolls. We hope these will spark your curiosity and evoke the sense of wonder we felt while we turned the pages and got lost in those mystical tales. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/af9b1faf2155c6b5cbab6eed9e2cae8896de13fc.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Ilmatar[/b] [/h2][p]
The air had a daughter: her name was [b]Ilmatar[/b]. Weary of her days and lonesome in the wide halls of the gods, Ilmatar dove down into the wide, gleaming world below. When she descended from the high heavens into the sea, the waves embraced her, and in their union she became the Water-Mother, heavy with a child not yet born.  
 
For nine ages Ilmatar drifted, her womb full, her spirit aching. She lifted her knee above the waters, and a goldeneye laid its eggs upon her. The heat of the nesting grew fierce: Ilmatar, wincing, shifted her knee, and the eggs tumbled into the waves. They shattered not into ruin, but into becoming. [b]From their shards came the world[/b]. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/2fe88409795b8a0f7b2e750166043b4338a0b17f.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]The Birth of Väinämöinen[/b] [/h2][p]
From the darkness of Ilmatar’s womb, the unborn [b]Väinämöinen[/b] wept and spoke to the gods, but they would not open the path. And so he opened it himself. For nine years he floated on the waves, old though newborn, until at last he touched land. [/p][p]A sage from the moment of his first breath, with beard white as river-fog and eyes that had seen the shape of stars from within the womb. He wandered the newborn land alone, until he met Sampsa Pellervoinen, the Son of the Field.   [/p][p]Together they carved space for the seeds of life - cutting trees, sowing grain, calling forth the first harvests of the human age. And so Väinämöinen, son of the sea and of sky-born Ilmatar, became not just witness to the world, [b]but its maker and its memory[/b]. 
[/p]

notes.title: Between Realities: Devlog #5
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/d380cf4989b4255c29b1e1811ca3a7ac3e6a02dc.png"][/img]
[/p][p]“[i]It is said that in the waters around the islands, the Aallottaret are hiding. Water nymphs who were once women drowned, consumed by envy for the living. They grab you and drag you down without mercy. I still haven’t figured out whether they do it to keep people from reaching the islands… or to make sure they never leave.[/i]” [/p][p]  [/p][p]Over the past month, we’ve focused on bringing life (and danger) to the waters of Among the Trolls. In today’s devlog, we’ll take a closer look at the [b]swimming system[/b] in the archipelago, how it affects exploration - and your survival. Ready to take the plunge? [/p][p]  [/p][p][b]INTO THE CURRENT[/b] [/p][p]The sea surrounding the archipelago - the one Anna used to secretly swim in during summer as a child, without her grandfather knowing - no longer feels the same. Something is off, and those clear, calm waters that once filled her memories now seem unfamiliar: the water that laps the shore no longer seems to follow the rules of the [i]real [/i]sea, as if her swimming skills mean nothing against its hostility. Swimming here has become excessively - and [i]unnaturally[/i] - exhausting for Anna.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/8ae4c614234fa6718827ba4f9fddd3852f81f1fc.gif"][/img][/p][p]The islands of the archipelago are home to a variety of environments, but one thing they all share are the sandy shores that stretch into deep waters. Choosing to swim there can be risky - it’s up to you to weigh the dangers. [/p][p]Movement in water is slower, and can be extremely tiring for Anna. While swimming, stamina drains quickly, and if you push yourself too hard, you'll soon run out of energy and run the risk of drowning.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/bc65c8c90fe61c8edab124c4fd97fc681db046c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But not all waters are the same. Swimming in island lakes is certainly less dangerous than swimming in the ocean. Out there, as you move away from the coast, you'll find the dark Deep Sea. If you cross into it, stamina depletes even faster, the world begins to distort and turns hostile. A true boundary, as solid as any wall. [b]You can’t cross the open sea without building a bridge[/b] - because some waters are too dangerous and must be avoided at all costs.[/p][p]And exhaustion isn’t the only threat. Enemies can chase Anna all the way to the shoreline - though they probably won’t follow you into the tides. Still, keep in mind that tools are useless in water: axes, bows, and spears can’t be used until you’re back on land. If Anna falls in with a heavy load, she’ll have to let it go in order to survive. One missed handhold, one misjudged jump, and the current claims another secret for the [i]Aallottaret.[/i] [/p][p]

We’re working hard to make the waters of Among the Trolls as unpredictable and mysterious as the landscape. Whether you're wading between islands or simply hearing the wave crashing in the distance, remember: [i]sometimes, it's not what you can see on the surface that you should fear - but what's down below.[/i] [/p][p]  [/p][p]That wraps up today’s devlog. The next one will be coming in September![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Between Realities: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/d380cf4989b4255c29b1e1811ca3a7ac3e6a02dc.png"][/img][i]

“These passages… I've never laid eyes on them. 
Spires of solid stone corridors, built with an architecture I don't comprehend, carved by hands that shouldn't be possible.[/i] [i]Did my grandfather hide them from me?[/i] 
[i]Etched on these walls, somehow, I recognize the ancient myths he used to speak.[/i] 
[i]Who built this place - and where does it go?[/i] 
[i]Perhaps the crow knows more than it's letting on. Time to get some answers.”[/i] [/p][p][i] [/i] [/p][p]Over the past month, we’ve ventured deeper into the mysteries surrounding the [b]dungeons [/b]of [i]Among the Trolls[/i], the focus of our fourth [b][i]Between Realities[/i] devlog[/b]! 
[/p][p]Ready to descend into the depths and uncover more? [/p][p][/p][h3][b]INTO THE DEPTHS[/b] [/h3][p]Hidden behind thick stone walls and away from prying eyes, deep within the forests that stretch across the archipelago you’ll explore in [i]Among the Trolls[/i],[b] lie places as ancient as the world itself[/b]. Here, some secrets are carefully kept out of sunlight. [/p][p]It’s in these strange - and far from safe - places that the protagonist’s story begins to intertwine with old legends and long-buried truths. With every step, every exploration, you’ll uncover something new. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/7cf22599b8b07d0f2dbda012b2d7cf140e40beb4.png"][/img][i]Work-in-progress screenshots. Assets are still subject to change.
[/i][/p][p]As we craft our dungeons, [b]atmosphere [/b]remains foremost in our minds. We want players to have that unique sensation of being lost - of venturing through halls carved by invisible hands, where curiosity alone is the compass. We want you to feel absolutely present in a place outside of time, where a faint glow, your tools, and your keen intuition will be your only guides. [/p][p]Of course, as you might expect, not all of the encounters will be [i]friendly[/i]. The secrets buried deep below have guardians of their own, and these have made the darkened corridors their home. These combat encounters will test your fighting skills and resource management - and you'll need to keep your wits about you to find your way back to the world you once knew. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/057a06e33c3b54e4d028ce698700044f354fb555.gif"][/img] [i]Work-in-progress video. Assets are still subject to change.[/i]
[/p][p]We're working hard to bring all of these elements together, buffing lighting, sound, and all the tiny details to make each dungeon a unique exploration experience. Things are moving along steadily, and we can't wait for you to lose yourselves in the depths - to discover the hidden pieces of story that we've left behind these ancient walls. [/p][p][/p][p]As always, we invite you to follow us on our social media channels ([url="https://x.com/AmongTheTrolls"]X[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/AmongTheTrolls/"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/amongthetrolls.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/amongthetrolls/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@amongthetrolls"]TikTok[/url]) and join our [url="https://discord.gg/fkC24Q3ymj"]official Discord[/url] to share your feedback and stay up to date on our progress.[/p]

notes.title: Between Realities: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/d380cf4989b4255c29b1e1811ca3a7ac3e6a02dc.png[/img]

Another month of intense work has gone by, and it's time for our third "[i]Between Realities[/i]" devlog 🪓 

This time, we want to update you on the progress we’re making as we move closer, day by day, to the Early Access release. We'll give you a glimpse into some crafting and building dynamics, with a special focus on something that will allow you to explore areas that initially seem out of reach: [b]bridges[/b]! 

[h2]THE WAY OF THE LUMBERJACK [/h2]

Over the past month, the team has focused on several core aspects of the gameplay experience. We’ve introduced new crafting logic, defined basic behaviors for various types of monsters, and enriched the game world with assets, atmospheric dynamics, and dungeons. The world of [i]Among the Trolls[/i] is coming to life more and more each day, and in such a dense forest, a [b]large number of towering trees[/b] is a must - they’re an extremely valuable resource for anyone trying to survive under their canopy. 

Naturally, you'll be able to cut down trees on the island and [b]use the wood in many ways[/b], but this action won’t be purely functional: it reflects the relationship between humans and nature - a give and take that must be done with respect. 

This month, we’ve worked on improving tree physics and animations - for example, how the trunk falls and splits into different parts. We’ve also refined the look of the logs (which Anna can physically carry), as well as the branches and twigs that can be collected and used for crafting and environmental interactions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/167d2a9c7cf20f4e6c4cfb2d146c83afa068c40e.jpg[/img]
[i]Work-in-progress screenshots. Assets are still subject to change.[/i]

Cut wood can be used in a variety of ways, but today we’re focusing on one in particular: building your ticket to explore previously unreachable areas... sturdy bridges. 

[h2]ALTERNATIVE PATHS: BRIDGES [/h2]

In the wild world of [i]Among the Trolls[/i], you won’t just find pre-marked roads or convenient trails - sometimes you’ll need to find alternate paths to reach your goals, or even create them yourself. 

We recently introduced the [b]bridge-building system[/b], which allows you to use the wood you've gathered to construct custom connections - whether it’s to reach a distant island or to cross a challenging path. 

Using a ghost placement system and smart anchor points, you’ll be able to preview where each part of the bridge will go, with full control over the rotation of each piece so you can build around any obstacles. We've worked on feedback systems that will always ensure the structure you’re building is "valid," so you never risk reaching the end only to find you can’t place the final piece. 

Thanks to these constructions, you'll gain access to new islands, secrets, and - who knows - maybe even forgotten creatures. Bridges will also require maintenance, and you’ll be able to dismantle the ones you no longer need to recover valuable materials. We can't wait to see all the creative ways you'll use them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/ef980aacafc08f3ee5ad00ade1a1451dacf39c9a.gif[/img]
[i]Work-in-progress clip. Assets are still subject to change.[/i]

We’ve reached the end of this devlog and, as always, feel free to share your questions with us, they’ll help shape our future devlogs! 

We also invite you to follow us on our social media channels ([url=https://x.com/AmongTheTrolls]X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/AmongTheTrolls/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/amongthetrolls.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/amongthetrolls/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@amongthetrolls]TikTok[/url]) and join our [url=https://discord.gg/fkC24Q3ymj]official Discord[/url] to share your feedback and stay up to date on our progress.

notes.title: Between Realities: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/d380cf4989b4255c29b1e1811ca3a7ac3e6a02dc.png[/img]

Welcome to our second "[i][b]Between Realities[/b][/i]" devlog, where we’ll update you each month on the latest developments and behind-the-scenes insights into our work on [b]Among The Trolls[/b]! 

This month, we’d like to introduce you to our protagonist, Anna, and what led her to embark on this unexpected journey - to a land that should have felt familiar but turned out to be [i]something else[/i]. We’ll also dive deeper into the game’s survival mechanics and our approach to these systems. 

[h2]INTO THE UNKNOWN [/h2]

The protagonist of our story is [b]Anna[/b], a sharp and determined 35-year-old woman who spent years as a successful lawyer. However, at a certain point in her life, her deep passion for nature convinced her to leave the courtroom behind and pursue a career in forestry, trading legal battles for untamed landscapes. 

Raised in the [b]United States[/b], every summer, her[b] Finnish roots[/b] called her back to spend peaceful days on her grandfather’s island alongside her brother, Jonas. Perhaps it was among those trees that her love for flora and fauna first blossomed - learning to navigate the woods, one scraped knee at a time. 

Now, something is calling her back to the island of her childhood. But [b]Jonas isn’t with her, and her grandfather isn’t waiting at the dock like he always did[/b]. Something feels off. The place that once felt like home now seems… [i]different[/i]. The colors, the sounds, and the creatures that inhabit it may no longer be the ones she once studied as a child in dusty old science books about local wildlife. And maybe, just maybe, the island itself[i] is not where it should be[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/8dc13f51e5b2a9697d7afeb2ce82e429d0a04387.png[/img]

[h2]SURVIVING THE WILDERNESS [/h2]

When Anna sets foot on her grandfather’s island, [b]survival becomes key[/b]. The survival system is one of the game’s core pillars and has been carefully designed to integrate seamlessly with the rest of the mechanics. It revolves around four primary needs: [b]hunger[/b], [b]thirst[/b], [b]sleep[/b], and [b]temperature[/b]. 

The goal is to encourage players to [b]explore and interact[/b] with the world around them. Food can be found, cooked, or hunted; sleep becomes necessary over time and is affected by the day/night cycle and weather conditions; cold, especially at night or in certain areas, must be countered with fire or shelter - and so on. 

All these survival needs are connected to [b]Lykky[/b], the balance of the region’s energies. The lower the Lykky, the more hostile the world becomes: animals grow more aggressive, resources become scarcer, and tools wear out faster. 

You'll be able to monitor Anna’s needs not just through the [b]in-game HUD[/b], but also through [b]visual and audio cues[/b] that reflect her physical state. Survival is important, but rather than feeling like a punishment, we want it to be a [b]constant invitation[/b] to engage with the world around you: gathering what you need, learning how to use resources wisely, and making the right choices at the right time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/70207652c9827ee5a8d5099aea8b66cc12bea517.gif[/img]

As always, feel free to share your questions with us, they’ll help shape our future devlogs! 

We also invite you to follow us on our social media channels ([url=https://x.com/AmongTheTrolls]X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/AmongTheTrolls/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/amongthetrolls.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/amongthetrolls/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@amongthetrolls]TikTok[/url]) and join our [url=https://discord.gg/fkC24Q3ymj]official Discord[/url] to share your feedback and stay up to date on our progress.

notes.title: Between Realities: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/d380cf4989b4255c29b1e1811ca3a7ac3e6a02dc.png[/img]

Welcome to our first [b]devlog[/b] "Between Realities", where we'll update you each month on the latest developments and behind-the-scenes insights into our work on [b]Among The Trolls[/b]! 

Since our announcement in January, we've started sharing glimpses of the game's gameplay on our social media - where we highly recommend following us if you want to see them in real-time - and answering some questions on our official Discord. 

Today, [b]we'll shed some light on the work we've done over the past few months[/b], our thoughts, and what you can expect to experience in the world of Among The Trolls. 

[h2]STRONG FOUNDATIONS ARE KEY [/h2]

As you already know, the project has been entirely rebuilt to transition from Unity to Unreal Engine 5, a crucial step on multiple levels. First, we wanted to leverage more advanced technology to achieve [b]dynamic and realistic lighting[/b], allowing us to better recreate the atmosphere of the Finnish forests - the primary inspiration for Among The Trolls' setting. On the other hand, this transition also impacted the [b]art direction[/b], leading us to revisit many assets and shaders to maximize their visual quality and reach a higher level of detail. 

Once we made this decision and established the foundations, we spent the following months focusing on implementing the [b]core gameplay mechanics[/b], such as the survival systems that will define your time on the archipelago, resource management, environmental changes, and combat. 

[previewyoutube=Rm-Te0b-5cs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ENEMIES AND CHALLENGES [/h2]

Once you set foot on the island, you'll quickly realize that the archipelago hides various [b]threats[/b], across different... realities. [b]Learning how to survive among them will be crucial[/b], as will understanding them to take advantage of their resources, nuances, and dangers. One of these threats comes in the form of hostile characters you'll encounter throughout your adventure, whose behavior has been a key focus of our work in recent months. 

We want the enemies you face to have dynamic and [b]responsive behavior[/b], reacting to your actions and adapting to their surroundings. Each enemy will have a unique attack pattern: some will attack in packs, while others will prefer a different approach, using ambush tactics. It will be up to you to figure out the best way to fend them off and stay alive. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/b694e60c28ce18b1f4566a3008d39261dfd0d0c9.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]BETWEEN MYTH AND REALITY [/h2]

We want Among The Trolls to be more than just a survival experience but, as you may have gathered, a [b]true journey between different realities[/b], separated only by a thin veil. The story follows [b]Anna[/b], the protagonist, looking for her missing grandfather and finding herself immersed in an unexpected world ruled by ancient forces and forgotten spirits. 

The narrative we are crafting draws inspiration from [b]Finnish mythology[/b] and the [i][b]Kalevala[/b][/i], Finland’s national epic, shaping a setting where the boundary between reality and myth is dissolving. This will inevitably lead to the emergence of legendary creatures and supernatural phenomena, many of which are deeply rooted in folklore. 

In the coming months, we hope to immerse you even further into the atmosphere we are meticulously crafting for this project. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/becf8658669311915f71154a0bfaee9b4c71cd69.png[/img]

At this point, all that’s left is to ask you to share your questions with us so that we can collect them for our next devlog! 

We also invite you to follow us on our social media channels ([url=https://x.com/AmongTheTrolls]X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/AmongTheTrolls/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/amongthetrolls.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/amongthetrolls/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@amongthetrolls]TikTok[/url]) and join our [url=https://discord.gg/fkC24Q3ymj]official Discord[/url] to share your feedback and stay up to date on our progress. 

See you soon, explorers!

notes.title: Among The Trolls: A new Beginning.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/0e31f7beb07ad0c272d31b67fc250ba22b6cb846.png[/img]

Dear Players, 

It’s been a while since we last talked about Among the Trolls, and [b]a lot has happened behind the scenes[/b]. After months of hard work, we’re finally ready to announce that the project is back on track, with plenty of exciting updates and changes we can’t wait to share with you! 
 
[previewyoutube=EwIQBA0omco;full][Trailer] [/previewyoutube]

Let’s start from the beginning: what is [i]Among the Trolls[/i]? 

Set on a secluded Finnish archipelago, Among the Trolls invites you to explore lush forests, survive against the odds, and unravel ancient mysteries. One of the core pillars we aim for is letting you experience a dynamic, living world where [b]your actions not only affect survival but also influence the environment and its creatures[/b]. 

One of the biggest changes to this project lies in its development. After the closure of Forbidden Studio - the team that originally laid the groundwork for [i]Among the Trolls[/i] - 505 Games decided to keep supporting the project by entrusting it to the passionate developers at Avantgarden Games, who are working hard to bring this experience to life with their own unique vision. 

[b]Starting from scratch in 2024 [/b]and with a new engine - transitioning from [i]Unity [/i]to [i]Unreal [/i]- the new team has respectfully embraced the soul of [i]Among the Trolls[/i], [b]breathing it into something personal and unique[/b]. We hope you’ll appreciate their efforts as we share more with you in the coming months. 

By now, the most attentive among you might have noticed that the game is no longer published by 505 Games on Steam, but rather by [b]505 Pulse[/b]. This is none other than [b]505 Games’ indie division[/b], specializing in projects from independent studios that often take their first steps through Early Access! 

We know, it’s a lot to take in. But we wanted to provide an overview of the current situation and starting point, because now it’s time to move on to the most exciting part: [b]the journey to Early Access[/b]. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400298/3a4cd5415b28479d4ceaed83d6f7065071aff156.png[/img]

While we can’t share a release date just yet, we’re ready to give you glimpses into the game’s world as it takes shape. There are new characters, creatures, challenges, and threats we can’t wait to introduce to you, and we hope you’ll join us on this journey despite the challenges. We firmly believe it will be worth it. 

In the meantime, we invite you to join the discussion on our [url=https://discord.gg/fkC24Q3ymj]official Discord[/url], read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1675260/discussions/0/599642557974064375/]updated FAQs[/url], explore our revamped Steam page, and follow us on social media to stay up-to-date with all the upcoming news. 

If you have any questions, leave them here, and we’ll do our best to answer them or use them as inspiration for our next devlog.

Here’s to the beginning of a new journey, explorers 🍻

notes.title: Ex Skyrim devs reveal Finnish folklore survival game
notes.notes:
An indie studio of industry veterans who have worked on RPG games like Skyrim and Fallout 4 is building a new fantasy survival game about exploring the Finnish forest and meeting the mythical creatures who call it their home. The game is Among the Trolls, and it was announced at the 505 Games Spring Showcase earlier today.

Among the Trolls casts players as either Alex or Anna, a Finnish-American in their mid-30s who has traveled to their grandparents home in rural Finland to explore their family's roots. However, upon arrival at your grandparents' isolated cabin, you discover that they've disappeared and are pulled into a world that exists beyond the boundaries of our own - where the trolls live.

The trailer provides a glimpse at the world Forbidden Studios is creating for Among the Trolls - it's dense woodland, a place of golden sunlight breaking through the trees to briefly chase away the dark shadows. There's an air of menace to it, too: "I asked grandmother what happens when 'the folk' are angry," the narrator says. "I didn't sleep that night."

Read the rest of the story...
